text: あおく　ひかり　かがやく　とても　うつくしい　ほうせき。

structure.jp: あおく　ひかり　かがやく
とても　うつくしい　ほうせき。

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あおく　ひかり　かがやく　とても　うつくしい　ほうせき
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed in front of a thing describes that thing, like 'that ...' in English. あおく ひかり かがやく ほうせき = 'a gem that shines brilliantly blue'.

patterns.name: 〜く (adverb)
patterns.span: あおく　ひかり　かがやく
patterns.explanation: Changing the last い of a describing word to く makes it tell how an action happens. あおく ひかり かがやく = 'shines brilliantly blue'.
